say: I paid for lessons, not for falling into a rut. Well. I paid for some falling.
Bad week. I've been skating for a month and I feel like I've gone backwards. Literally, once.
@how_are_things

options.text: I'm sorry. What would make it better?
It's an old building. Bear with us.
Rinks are hard. Take it or leave it.

say: Lesson night! Penny says I'm ready to let go of the boards. The boards and I disagree.
{event}. Today we learn to stop. I've been stopping already. Into things.
I'm on skates. I'm upright. That's two out of three.

options.text: You've got this.
Mind the boards.

say: Evening lessons. I've had a full day of work and now I fall over for fun.
After work, before dinner, on ice. My doctor said get a hobby. I don't think she meant this.

options.text: Good to see you anyway.

say: {owner}! I did a glide last week. Three seconds. Witnessed.
Oh hi! You're the one who said I could do this. I'm doing it. Badly. But doing it.

options.text: Good to see you too, {known_as}.

say: @how_are_things
Hi! Give me a sec, I'm not used to standing still on these.
Hello! I'm holding the boards. I'm also listening. Multi-tasking.

options.text: How are the lessons going?
What brings you to the rink?
What do you make of the rink?
Who else is in your class?
What would make this place better for you?
Take care.

say: Week four. I can stand. Week five, I'm told, I can turn. Very exciting.
My grandkids skate like little birds. I skate like a filing cabinet. But a moving one.
Penny's a saint. She says 'bend your knees' like it's the answer to everything. It is.

options.text: That's real progress.
Tell me a bit about yourself.
Glad you come.
Good to know you, {known_as}.

say: The rental skates fit like a bucket on each foot. Two different buckets.
The ice has texture. I didn't know ice had texture until I met it with my face.
@ice

options.text: The ice has been better lately, hasn't it?
Noticed the work on the building?
Fair enough. We're working on it.

say: The ice is smoother now! I only fell on purpose. I'm lying, but it's smoother.
Good ice. It forgives you a bit. That's all I need from ice.

options.text: Glad it shows.

say: There's a bench in the lobby that doesn't wobble. I sat on it for a long time. Happily.
The rental counter's nicer. They even asked my size.

options.text: That's the idea.

say: Walter Oduya wired half the paper mill and never once skated. He's in my class. He's worse than me. I love him.
Marisol's in my group. She grew up in Manila and never skated. She's better than all of us already.

options.text: Ha. Good to know.

say: Rental skates that actually fit. Sharp ones. In half sizes. I'm dreaming, I know.
Better rentals. Mine had a lace that was mostly a knot.

options.text: I'll see what I can do.
Can't promise anything, but noted.
You're not the first to say it. It's on the list.

say: Right. Back out there. Pray for my tailbone.
Bye! If you see me on the ice, don't wave. I'll wave back and fall.
